senses.gloss: m. (√אוו, v. אְוַשׁ; cmp. Syr. וזא, a. וזוז bombum edit, P. Sm. 1060) [the noisy], goose.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 57a:9">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה א׳ וכ׳</he> he who sees a goose in his dream, may hope for wisdom (with ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 1:20">Prov. I, 20</cite>, ‘wisdom cries’ &c.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:8:3">Y. B. Kam. V, end 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲוַוז ים וא׳ יישוב וכ׳</he> the water goose (bernicle) and the domestic goose are two diff. species (<cite ref="K00674"><he>כלאים</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:4:7">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ עם א׳ מדבר וכ׳</he> the (domestic) goose and the goose of the steppes (wild g.); <he>א׳ עם א׳ הים</he> the domestic and the water goose; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 55a:10">B. Kam. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ וא׳ הבר</he> (Ms. M. marg. <he>אֲוַוז בית וא׳ בר</he>) the domestic and the wild g.; <cite ref="Bekhorot 8a:3">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite>
